{"basis":"measured","confidence":1.0,"fact_type":"observation","statement":"A WRONG DEFAULT THAT CANNOT BE CORRECTED IS WORSE THAN A REQUIRED FIELD. dev_storyflow 2026-09-05: add_verification, called without level/method for a static code inspection, produced a Verification that READS level: unit, method: test. set_verification_kind cannot change either — VerificationKindReq (service.rs:1524) takes verification_id and kind ONLY. So 'the Y0 measurement — an inspection at system level — is recorded as a unit test forever unless I delete and recreate it', which the graph's own doctrine discourages. Three set_verification_kind calls were rejected learning this.

WHERE THE READING COMES FROM: schema/verify.yaml declares method default: test, level default: unit. Whether those are WRITTEN on an omitted field or supplied by the READER (dec:the-safe-reading-lives-in-the-reader-not-the-store) was NOT established — no inject path was found by name in a quick grep, weakly favouring read-supplied, but unmeasured. It does not change the defect: either way the node reads unit/test and nothing can move it.

THE SAME SHAPE ON add_epoch: temporal.rs:512 sets name, epoch_type, sequence and no status; AddEpochReq (service.rs:3157) has no status and no description. An epoch reads `arrived` by schema default until set_epoch_status follows — for the node type whose purpose is planning (cap:planned-epochs) — and the reporter 'avoided the constructor entirely', building both epochs through create_node. Wishes #6/#10, reported before, still open.

TWO FIXES, BOTH ADDITIVE: (1) set_verification_kind accepts optional level and method — wish #25. (2) add_epoch accepts status and description. The second brushes dec:idea-four-sibling-constructors-four-status-contracts (open) — but `planned` is the WEAKER claim than the `arrived` default reading, so accepting it asserts less, not more.
